name: KromiumLoadError
summary: Represents a failure that occurred during page navigation or loading.
declaration:
data class KromiumLoadError(
    val errorCode: Int,
    val errorText: String,
    val failedUrl: String
)

constructors.signature: KromiumLoadError(errorCode: Int, errorText: String, failedUrl: String)

parameters.name: errorCode
parameters.description: Numeric error code indicating the cause of the failure.

parameters.name: failedUrl
parameters.description: The URL that failed to load.
